name: Pure Faithful Saves
description: Saves that can't lose your world: chunks, level.dat, player and map files are written so a crash or power cut leaves the old version or the new one, never a damaged one, and a chunk that can't be read is kept and reported instead of silently regenerated over. The files stay in b1.7.3's own format.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
